title: Siege of Cusco (1781)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Cusco (1781)", at revision 1370740510, opens: "The Siege of Cusco, also known as the Battle of Cusco, was one of the most decisive engagements during the first phase of the Rebellion of Túpac Amaru II. Túpac Amaru II's main rebel army, despite warnings from other leaders to act earlier, sieged Cusco on 4 January, 1781. The first set of reinforcements sent from Lima led by Gabriel de Avilés arrived days earlier. Royalists were able to successfully defend the city, with Túpac Amaru ordering the retreat of the rebel army between on 11 January." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11794853, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1781 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
